name: berserk
desc:
Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} starts its turn with 60 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attacks the nearest creature it can see.
If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.
